text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I step into my office to find it
packed
with totally unfamiliar exercise
equipment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well... I've gone over my target weight
recently,
so I started looking into
exercise equipment. It
turns out there's a
wider variety than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I figured I may as well try all of them, so
I bought
the whole kit and caboodle. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's try this one out first. It vibrates
your
stomach via electric shock!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what would happen if we tried
it
somewhere else. Let's try it on your
cheeks!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Hehe, this zero-gravity
treadmill is so
cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond ends up getting back
to her
target weight while playing with
her new exercise
equipment.
